messages:
maya: FYI deploy-bot just flagged a p95 latency regression on canary in eu-west-1 :rotating_light:
jon: saw it, thanks. How big is the delta?
deploy-bot: Alert: canary-deploy v3.6.0 -> p95 increased from 210ms to 650ms over last 10m. Error rate steady.
carol: that jump is above our rollback threshold (p95 > 2x baseline for 5m). agree we need to consider a manual rollback.
dave: +1 to manual rollback. We should pin traffic and not roll forward until we confirm root cause.
pm_liz: customer comms? Any impacted customers to pre-notify?
jon: no major customer pages yet, but early heads-up to big customers is good. I'll draft a one-paragraph note after we decide.
sre-oncall: before we flip, can we try a targeted drain of canary pods and redeploy the previous image to 10% to validate? less blast radius.
carol: good idea. Proposal: 1) split 10% traffic -> v3.5.2 (previous stable) 2) monitor 10m for p95 & errors 3) if stable, move to 100% and pin release 3.5.2 for dedicated pools.
maya: timeline? I can run the split now if everyone agrees.
dave: go for it. command: 
```
# split traffic
deployctl traffic-split --service inference-canary --from v3.6.0 --to v3.5.2 --percent 10 --region eu-west-1
```
deploy-bot: Executing: traffic-split started. ETA 30s.
(30s later)
deploy-bot: traffic-split complete. v3.5.2 now serving 10% in eu-west-1.
jon: monitoring dashboards... p95 on 10% slice is 220ms, stable. 3.6.0 still at 650ms on remaining 90%.
sre-oncall: that’s promising. If 10% is stable, we should roll the remaining traffic back and pin.
carol: decision check: rollback to v3.5.2 across region, pin, and open a follow-up postmortem to track root cause and release note changes. Anyone object?
pm_liz: no objections — prepare customer blurb mentioning short degradation and rapid rollback, ETA for follow-up.
dave: executing global rollback now. command: 
```
deployctl rollback --service inference-canary --to v3.5.2 --region eu-west-1 --confirm
```
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated. Progress updates enabled.
(2m later)
deploy-bot: Rollback complete. v3.5.2 at 100% in eu-west-1.
jon: p95 back to 200-230ms, error rates unchanged.
maya: pinning release in release-config to prevent auto-rollforward: 
```
# pin config
release pin inference-canary v3.5.2 --reason "post-deploy latency regression" --owner @carol
```
deploy-bot: Pin applied. Auto-rollforward disabled for this service.
carol: opening postmortem ticket now and assigning to eng-runtime + perf. Also tagging docs to update release notes.
pm_liz: I put a short customer note in #customer-comms draft channel, will publish after legal sign-off.
sre-oncall: leaving a note in incident tracker: severity low since rollback was successful, but include timeline and decision criteria.
dave: small follow-ups: 1) add canary metric alert for 5m sustained 2x baseline 2) run quick perf comparison test between v3.6.0 and v3.5.2 on identical hardware.
jon: added both action items to the rollback ticket. Thanks everyone.
maya: thanks — closing this thread once postmortem and customer comms are posted. :white_check_mark:
